title: Disease model
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Tumor and healthy compartments can be approximated by the implemented simulator state variables and drug-effect mappings.
variables: tumor_cells, healthy_cells, growth parameters, carrying capacity, immune compromise, drug effect terms
validity_domain: Exploratory research simulations for structured/pseudonymized cases with sufficient longitudinal markers.
limitations: Not clinically validated; does not prove patient-level future outcome accuracy.
next_review_action: Attach reviewed mathematical references and validate compartment assumptions against external data before broader use.
notes: State variables include tumor burden and healthy plasma-cell compartment; growth, carrying capacity, immune compromise, and drug effects are implemented through the simulator mathematical model.

title: PK/PD model
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Drug presets and exposure summaries can stand in for a full individualized PK/PD model during exploratory research simulation.
variables: drug dose, schedule, exposure bridge parameters, effect coefficients
validity_domain: Internal what-if exploration where dose timing limitations are explicitly disclosed.
limitations: Schedule resolution is limited; identical trajectories may reflect exposure bridge collapse rather than biological equivalence.
next_review_action: Improve exposure bridge resolution and attach reviewed PK/PD sources before stronger claims.
notes: Drug presets and PK/PD mappings are resolved through simulator pharmaco presets. Schedule resolution remains limited for some dose patterns.

title: Observation model
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Latent compartments can be mapped to M-protein, FLC ratio, and hemoglobin signals using configurable observation parameters.
variables: m_protein_g_dl, flc_ratio, hemoglobin_g_dl, observation scaling parameters
validity_domain: Model-fit diagnostics over available structured biomarkers.
limitations: Observed biomarker mapping is simplified and not sufficient for clinical prediction.
next_review_action: Document mapping derivation and compare predicted biomarkers with held-out observations.
notes: Maps latent tumor and healthy compartments to M-protein, FLC ratio, and hemoglobin using configurable observation parameters.

title: Calibration
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Selected parameters can be fitted by minimizing residuals against available longitudinal observations.
variables: residuals, RMSE, MAE, objective_before, objective_after, n_observations, n_parameters
validity_domain: Research calibration diagnostics when observations are sufficiently complete.
limitations: Lower residuals do not prove clinical validity or causal identification.
next_review_action: Add uncertainty review, held-out validation, and sensitivity analysis.
notes: Fits selected model and observation parameters to longitudinal observed biomarkers using residual diagnostics and optimizer fallbacks.

title: Counterfactual semantics
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Alternative intervention definitions can be evaluated as mechanistic model branches.
limitations: Does not identify causal effects without external design and assumptions.
next_review_action: Separate mechanistic branch semantics from any future causal estimand workflow.
notes: Counterfactual means model-simulated alternative trajectory. It is not an empirically identified causal effect estimate.

title: Toxicity layer
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Observed toxicity context can constrain interpretation through descriptive summaries and heuristic penalties.
variables: AST, ALT, neutropenia events, infection events, therapy interruptions, toxicity_constraint_penalty
limitations: Does not yet simulate AST/ALT or NEU trajectories under alternative schedules.
next_review_action: Develop and validate mechanistic toxicity dynamics before predictive use.
notes: AST, ALT, neutropenia, infection, and interruption history are summarized descriptively. Predictive toxicity dynamics are not yet implemented.

title: Utility scoring
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Disease-control, healthy-compartment preservation, durability, and toxicity penalty terms can be combined for research ranking.
validity_domain: Heuristic prioritization for audit and research review.
limitations: Heuristic utility is not a treatment recommendation and not a validated clinical endpoint.
next_review_action: Review weighting, uncertainty, and clinical governance before any decision-copilot use.
notes: Research utility combines modeled disease-control terms and descriptive toxicity penalties for exploratory ranking.

title: Exposure bridge
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Structured intervention schedules can be mapped into time-resolved daily exposure profiles without changing real patient records.
validity_domain: Exploratory schedule-sensitive simulations where timing, interruptions, and average exposure must remain visible.
limitations: Time-resolved exposure remains a research bridge and does not claim clinical PK validity or causal effect estimation.
next_review_action: Attach PK/PD references and benchmark schedule-sensitive outputs before broader use.
notes: The exposure bridge distinguishes schedule timing, interruptions, and average exposure while preserving backward-compatible scalar summaries.

title: Schedule resolution classification
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Comparing exposure profiles and trajectory fingerprints can classify whether scenarios are distinct, collapsed, or missing required artifacts.
validity_domain: Internal developer diagnostics and cockpit warnings for schedule-sensitive scenario interpretation.
limitations: Classification helps audit model behavior but does not prove biological equivalence or nonequivalence.
next_review_action: Review tolerance thresholds and add stronger trajectory-comparison metrics if needed.
notes: The classification layer distinguishes same-average timing collapse from genuinely distinct outputs and missing artifacts.

title: Prototype toxicity dynamics
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Observed AST/ALT/NEU history plus modeled exposure can generate normalized research-only liver and neutropenia risk signals.
validity_domain: Research-only prototype risk signaling for cockpit comparison and heuristic utility scoring.
limitations: Signals are normalized prototype risk scores, not AST/ALT or neutrophil predictions, not clinically validated, and not causal effect estimates.
next_review_action: Calibrate against external toxicity datasets and document uncertainty before any stronger claim.
notes: The prototype exposes fitted/default coefficient status, observation counts, and explicit uncertainty labels in both cockpit and developer outputs.

title: Utility v2
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Prototype toxicity signals can be subtracted from the earlier research utility to make tradeoffs more explicit during research review.
validity_domain: Heuristic ranking for research audit and scenario comparison only.
limitations: Utility v2 is not a validated endpoint, not a treatment recommendation, and should not be interpreted as clinical decision support.
next_review_action: Review weights, uncertainty propagation, and governance before any broader use.
notes: Utility v2 extends research_utility by subtracting weighted prototype liver and neutropenia risk signals.

title: Scenario uncertainty propagation
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: When calibrated parameter distributions are unavailable, bounded heuristic perturbations can stress-test scenario stability without changing source clinical records.
variables: parameter_uncertainty_source, p05, p50, p95, interval_width, coefficient_of_variation, uncertainty_classification
validity_domain: Internal research stability review for mechanistic scenario outputs.
limitations: Intervals are exploratory perturbation diagnostics unless a calibrated parameter distribution is explicitly stored and validated.
next_review_action: Attach reviewed uncertainty methodology and replace heuristic scales with calibrated parameter distributions when available.
notes: The current implementation propagates bounded parameter and prototype-toxicity perturbations through the scenario runner and classifies interval width as narrow, moderate, or wide.

title: Rolling-origin backtesting
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Historical assessments can be split into sequential training and held-out evaluation windows to estimate one-step-ahead model agreement.
validity_domain: Internal research validation on recorded biomarker points only.
limitations: Held-out agreement on recorded biomarker points does not establish clinical validity or future treatment benefit.
next_review_action: Benchmark backtest error against curated external cohorts and define minimum evidence thresholds before stronger claims.
notes: Backtesting runs fit in memory to avoid overwriting the current patient twin state while still surfacing held-out residuals.

title: One-at-a-time sensitivity analysis
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Small one-at-a-time perturbations around the current parameterization can reveal which model or schedule knobs drive scenario scores most strongly.
validity_domain: Internal fragility review for mechanistic rankings.
limitations: Local perturbation sensitivity is not a global identifiability result and does not imply causal effect modification.
next_review_action: Add broader global sensitivity methods and compare driver rankings across cohorts before stronger interpretation.
notes: The current implementation ranks parameters and selected schedule knobs by their effect on utility_v2 under small positive and negative perturbations.

title: Robust scenario ranking
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Aligned scenario uncertainty samples can estimate probability-best, pairwise dominance, and ranking fragility.
variables: point_rank, robust_rank, probability_best, pairwise_dominance, overlap_with_next, robustness_classification
validity_domain: Internal research ranking review for multiple completed scenarios.
limitations: Robust ranking is still an exploratory ordering diagnostic and does not imply clinical superiority or causal identification.
next_review_action: Review ranking thresholds, interval-overlap heuristics, and decision-governance constraints before broader use.
notes: The current implementation contrasts point ranks with uncertainty-aware robust ranks and labels scenarios as robust, contested, or fragile.

title: Causal assumptions
citation: No peer-reviewed source is attached in the repository for this component.
assumptions: Causal graphs can document intended assumptions and identification status.
limitations: Stored assumptions do not prove identification; current single-patient branch remains mechanistic-only.
next_review_action: Define estimand, identification strategy, external data design, and sensitivity analysis before causal claims.
notes: Causal assumption sets document assumptions and labels but do not transform mechanistic simulations into identified causal effects.
